answer: A pulse of new walnut-trading agents is no signal of trust. Require an established sponsor to guarantee each newcomer contract with locked funds covering its maximum unpaid liability. The ledger reserves that amount from one shared sponsor balance until settlement; it grants no separate credit allowance per sponsored identity. Creating a thousand aliases cannot multiply the same guarantee, and default draws on the reserved funds. This bounds losses from Sybil credit farming, though it concentrates access around wealthy sponsors and requires enforceable, well-defined liabilities.
